scope: One-time retrospective empirical comparison; no app files or hosting changes.
primary_data: OpenSourceAP October 2026, standardized value-weighted quintiles, favorable quintile 05; no short or leverage. Source holding-period and availability conventions retained.
selection: Four well-established behavioral/information-related predictors published by 1996, chosen from conversation/literature before inspecting target-period returns. All 6 50/50 pairs and a 25%-each four-way mix. No fit/weight/threshold search.
cost_warning: Illustrative annual headwind, not measured spreads/commissions/turnover/taxes. No claims of executable net profit.
benchmark: CRSP US broad value-weighted market total return reconstructed as French Mkt-RF+RF; same currency, months, compounding. USD primary; optional EUR CAGR/drawdown check.
primary_objective: Annualized realized Sharpe under fixed 1% headwind, jointly inspect geometric benchmark excess and max month-end drawdown. No universal optimum implied.
inference: Paired mean log-return difference to market, HAC 12 lags, two-sided p, Holm adjustment over all 14 active portfolios. CAPM and FF5+momentum alpha secondary, Holm-adjusted within 14-strategy family. Paired circular block bootstrap 12 months, 10000 repetitions, common resamples; sensitivity 6 and 24. Simultaneous confidence intervals for 14 geometric excess means.
development_selection: Select largest development Sharpe among the 11 psychological portfolios only (fixed tie-break lexicographic), freeze, report evaluation. Also 10-year trailing Sharpe selection annually without future data, choosing only 11 psychological portfolios.
robustness: Identical fixed candidates on liquid-size-screened original-construction portfolios (formation/weight differences explicit); annual big-stock FF93-style separate structural sensitivity only because these signals update only every June. No selecting the best universe ex post.
exclusions: Baker-Wurgler sentiment timing excluded from confirmatory trading test: current index is revised and full-sample estimated, no verified historical release vintages. News/social text trading excluded: no audited historical timestamped archive with complete coverage and expectations.
bias_limits: Revised CRSP/Compustat/IBES histories, not full point-in-time commercial vintage audit.
Original literature and the analyst already know historical anomalies; retrospective evaluation is not a new genuinely unseen prospective test.
Publication/strategy-selection bias and source-code errors cannot be eliminated by multiple-test correction.
Monthly portfolio indices do not verify next-day fills, turnover, borrow, capacity or Austrian broker availability/tax.
Separate sleeves can overlap; equal sleeve weights are not an intersection stock-ranking strategy.
Behavioral interpretation does not establish psychological causation.
Conclusions limited to chosen US strategies and source conventions.
